techniques.name: Brute Force
techniques.justification: Multiple failed login attempts against the root user from an external IP indicate a brute-force attack.

techniques.name: Scanning IP Blocks
techniques.justification: Sequential port scanning activity from external IP addresses targeting the ssh server.

techniques.name: Brute Force
techniques.justification: Multiple failed passwords followed by a successful login for user deploy from an external IP.

techniques.name: Default Accounts
techniques.justification: Immediate sudo to root after successful login shows abuse of administrative access.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
techniques.justification: Massive data transfer over a suspicious port to an external IP immediately following unauthorized access.

techniques.name: Password Spraying
techniques.justification: An external IP attempts single failed logins across numerous distinct user accounts in rapid succession.

techniques.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
techniques.justification: Web application attack attempts including SQL injection and path traversal signatures.
